en-US.description: SenseTime AI voice input and AI agent workspace.
en-US.longDescription: SoWork by SenseTime combines AI voice input with AI agents: dictate accurately into any application and rewrite by voice; use 200+ AI agent experts organized into 15 AI departments; produce slides, web pages, and posters through the built-in S-Design platform using natural language; and dispatch AI agents remotely from WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, or QQ so tasks run in the background and results arrive in real time.

zh-CN.description: 商汤推出的 AI 语音输入与智能体办公工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: 商汤输入法 SoWork 将 AI 语音输入与智能体相结合：通过语音在任意应用中精准转写、说完即改写；内置 200 余个按真实企业场景组织的 Agent 专家与 15 个 AI 部门；集成一站式 AI 设计平台 S-Design，用自然语言完成幻灯片、网页、海报等内容生产；并支持在微信、飞书、钉钉或 QQ 中远程调度 AI Agent，让任务后台执行、结果实时送达。
zh-CN.name: 商汤输入法SoWork
